figures.finding: A national film, the kind the Lithuanian Film Centre funds, must be in Lithuanian or dubbed or subtitled in Lithuanian, with a Lithuanian director or screenwriter.
figures.applies: Lithuania, national films under the Law on Film.

sources.said: the film’s director, or the author of the screenplay or adapted literary work, is a citizen of the Republic of Lithuania; the film is in the Lithuanian language or is dubbed (subtitled) in Lithuanian if a foreign language is spoken in the film.
